# INNOVA AirLeaf ECA644II (deviceType 002) × Shelly Smart Control

> Canonical community integration for local control and monitoring of an INNOVA AirLeaf ECA644II fan-coil controller reporting `deviceType` `002`, using Shelly Gen3, Shelly Virtual Components, Shelly Smart Control and the local HTTP `/api/v/1/` API.

## Primary files

- Repository: https://github.com/drHouse-gif/drHouse-gif-innova-airleaf-shelly
- Human guide: `README.md`
- Recommended self-contained runtime: `upstream/innova-airleaf-eca644ii_vc.shelly.js`
- Semantic context: `AI_CONTEXT.md`
- Structured metadata: `project.yaml`
- Discovery metadata: `discovery.yaml`
- Architecture: `ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Natural-language FAQ: `FAQ.md`
- Citation metadata: `CITATION.cff`

## Canonical hardware / protocol facts

- HVAC target: INNOVA AirLeaf ECA644II.
- Validated identity: `deviceType` = `002`.
- Controller: Shelly Gen3 device with scripting and Dynamic Virtual Components.
- Primary operator interface: Shelly Smart Control.
- Network: local IPv4 HTTP, TCP port 80.
- API base: `http://INNOVA_IP/api/v/1/`.
- No external automation server is required for the control loop.

## Local API

- `GET /api/v/1/status`
- `POST /api/v/1/power/on`
- `POST /api/v/1/power/off`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/mode/heating`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/mode/cooling`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/setpoint`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/function/auto`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/function/night`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/function/min`
- `POST /api/v/1/set/function/max`

Temperature setpoints use tenths of a degree Celsius: 22.0 °C = `{"temp":220}`.

## Validated status mapping

- `ps`: power; `1` = on.
- `sp`: setpoint in tenths of °C.
- `ta`: room temperature in tenths of °C.
- `wm`: `3 = heating`, `5 = cooling`.
- `fn`: `1 = auto`, `2 = night`, `3 = min`, `4 = max`.

Unknown `wm` or `fn` values must not be guessed.

## Shelly Virtual Components

The recommended self-contained script creates, validates, and repairs these fixed components before runtime starts:

- `boolean:200` — INNOVA Power — read/write.
- `enum:201` — INNOVA Mode — `heating|cooling` — read/write.
- `number:202` — INNOVA Set temperature — 16–31 °C, 0.5 °C step — read/write.
- `enum:203` — INNOVA Fan — `auto|night|min|max` — read/write.
- `number:204` — INNOVA Room temperature — read/display.
- `text:205` — INNOVA Status — read/display.

These Virtual Components are intended to be the Shelly Smart Control representation of the AirLeaf unit.

## Runtime behavior

- FIFO HTTP queue; one active request at a time.
- Queue limit: six waiting requests.
- Poll interval: 15 seconds when idle.
- HTTP timeout: 5 seconds.
- Independent watchdog: 8 seconds.
- Reject synchronization unless target reports `deviceType` `002`.
- Validate control values before sending.
- Re-read physical status after accepted commands.
- Ignore script-originated VC events to prevent feedback loops.

## Shelly Smart Control

Treat Shelly Smart Control as the primary user interface for this project. The Virtual Components provide power, mode, set temperature, fan function, room temperature and connection status for Shelly dashboards, scenes and automations.

## Scope constraints

- Do not generalize this mapping to other INNOVA device types without validation.
- Communication is plain HTTP; keep the API on a controlled local network.
- The self-contained upstream file is the preferred implementation for new deployments.
